title: Child shares transferable post-lock but only redeemable via a Position (orphan shares)
root_cause: CarthaVault exposes no position-independent redeem; redemption is position-bound, but shares are ERC20-transferable once the lock expires (_update only blocks while locked). Shares moved to an address without a Position are non-redeemable yet still count in totalSupply.
attacker_entrypoint: CarthaVault ERC20 transfer of shares post-lock to a non-position address
attacker_capabilities: transfer/sell child shares after the lock expires

severity_justification.worst_case: User who acquires shares by transfer cannot redeem them.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Footgun; matters if child shares are traded.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: Cartha contest (cartha-vaults-main @ 4c51f2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: user's lock expires; user transfers/sells child shares
recipient has no Position; no redeem(shares) exists
recipient's shares are orphaned (non-redeemable) but still in totalSupply

state_transition.before: holder owns transferable child shares without a Position

asset_delta: Acquired-by-transfer shares are unrecoverable for the holder; orphan supply skews share price.
false_positive_risks: Footgun; matters if child shares are traded.

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: only blocks while locked; post-lock transfers create orphan shares

assumptions: perp deployment with 0xM pool wired (reader/oracle set)
triager_summary: Child shares transferable post-lock but only redeemable via a Position (orphan shares) — PASS: transferred shares orphaned - recipient holds 50k*1e12 shares, release/requestRelease revert (no Position), totalSupply unchanged
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors (child shares are ERC-20-transferable after lock but redemption is position-bound → transferred shares are not redeemable by the recipient)
